The '''2016 Rosemount Championship''' (RMC) was held on 12 June 2016 at Rosemount Middle School in Rosemount, Minnesota, for current and former Rosemount players. [[Mark Walseth]] organized it. 19 players entered. [[Charlie Arlandson]] won, beating [[Adam Schellberg|Adam S]] in the final.<ref name="rmc16">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=61545 RMC 2016 - Rosemount, MN], forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May – 13 June 2016). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004612/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t61545.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Rosemount Middle School, Rosemount, Minnesota<ref name="rmc16" />
* '''Date:''' 12 June 2016<ref name="rmc16" />
* '''Structure:''' 5 games modified Swiss (SoS), then 2 rounds of modified match play for the top 4<ref name="rmc16" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="rmc16" />
* '''Field:''' 19 players<ref name="rmc16" />

Places 1–4 are after the match-play finals; places 5–19 are the Swiss standings. In the semi-finals Charlie beat Bryan and Adam beat Sean. Prizes included a sealed Death Star II box and a Third Anthology set donated by an anonymous community member, and a plane ticket to the 2016 World Championship.<ref name="rmc16" />
